cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): the fundamental course or principle that underlies and orders reality, conduct, or the world
cards.Nuance (English): In this text it is a technical philosophical term, not an ordinary road or mere method.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese, especially early philosophical text in the Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): a physical way or route for travel, movement, or passage
cards.Nuance (English): Concrete, spatial sense rather than the philosophical one.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The road lies ahead.|Proceed along the path.|There is a spring by the road.|The cart goes out onto the road.
cards.Sentences: 大道在前。|循道而行。|道旁有泉。|車出道中。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): to speak of, state, or utter something
cards.Nuance (English): Often introduces or reports speech, explanation, or description.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The minister stated the reason.|The teacher explained the ancient meaning.|He spoke of right and wrong.|The elder gave his name.
cards.Sentences: 臣道其故。|師道古義。|彼道是非。|老者道其名。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): to be able to do something, or to be permitted or suitable to do it
cards.Nuance (English): Here it marks potential or possibility, not approval as an adjective.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese, especially the Laozi/Wang Bi recension in early philosophical prose
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): deserving approval, fitting, or allowed under the relevant standard
cards.Nuance (English): Describes what is fit to be accepted or allowed, not mere ability.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): This plan is workable.|His words are acceptable.|This person is pleasant to approach.|His proposal can be followed.
cards.Sentences: 此策可行。|其言可取。|斯人可親。|其議可從。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): a marker of negation that denies a predicate, quality, or relation
cards.Nuance (English): Used here as straightforward verbal negation, not as a noun or adjective.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese, especially the Laozi/Wang Bi recension in early philosophical prose
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): being contrary to what is right, proper, or true
cards.Nuance (English): Used predicatively to judge something as erroneous or contrary to the proper way.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): That account is wrong.|Those words are mistaken.|That course is not right.|This action is not good.
cards.Sentences: 其說非也。|是言非矣。|彼道非正。|此舉非善。
